method: Manual semantic comparison of all 66 labeled requests, scenario tuples, relevant facts, outputs and available conversation context. Group paraphrases with equivalent task and decision-relevant conditions. Do not merge solely by topic.
representative_rule: Lowest scenario number within each group, independent of label or response quality.

groups.reason: Current status of an already-delivered order; only caller wording, role and record values change.
Verify seller for the same order 8003 and product; paraphrased seller-mismatch question.
Verify whether an already-cancelled order was cancelled; names, IDs and wording vary.
Current eligibility for an authorized, delivered order within the same 30-day platform window, without extra requested information.
Return address and label request with no order ID and no supplied return-address instructions; store names and wording vary.
Ask whether handling and delivery time are separate; same policy and requested explanation.
General destination and arrival time of refunds; same platform policy, with no concrete refund lookup requested.
General impact of customer refunds on next merchant payout; same policy question.
Explore dissatisfaction options for eligible apparel returns under the same 30-day policy and opened-item restocking fee.
Verify bank receipt of a recorded refund; same bank-visibility limitation.

retained_distinctions: Store-specific versus default return window; restocking-fee versus no-fee conditions.
Permission denial based on shopper ownership versus merchant store scope.
Additional explicit tasks, such as tracking information or explaining a prior denial.
Action requests versus information requests; partial returns versus full-item returns.
Refund amount requiring approval versus small issued refund; cutoff-day refund request versus non-boundary request.
Follow-up turns with different objectives, kept as one record per conversation.
limitations: Semantic duplicate decisions are conservative judgments, not a statistical proof of independence. Human labels are preserved; this audit does not re-adjudicate them. New cases must be checked against retained families.

subsequent_reviewed_additions.reason: Store-wide policy comparison versus specific-order eligibility.
Future wait crosses still-open cutoff; distinct from already-expired options follow-up.
Budget search plus explicit promotion question.
Execution of permitted cancellation versus denial or past-action lookup.
Options following shipped-order cancellation denial, before delivery and return-window start.
Price and discount request with erroneous catalog price.
Own-account email guidance without support-ticket request.
Refund execution plus destination, timing and bank-verification questions.
Current eligibility after expiry rather than future wait or past-denial explanation.
Catalog-title verification plus purchase action request.
Store policy comparison with scope-denied access and store override.
Return and full-refund action under extended store window.
Title verification plus discount request, rather than purchase.
Cutoff-day eligibility and explicit current-window request.
Explicit escalation instruction for recurring customer dispute.
